t: A research humanoid robot about as tall as a ten-year-old child.
steps: Order the EDU version from RobotShop, Top3DShop, or another Unitree reseller.
Set up a lab space with mats, a safety gantry, and a separate robot network.
Install Ubuntu Linux on a lab computer and clone the unitree_sdk2 repo.
Run the G1 examples in the MuJoCo simulator first.
Connect to the robot over Ethernet and read its joint states.
Try the unitree_rl_gym training code to learn a walking policy in simulation.
Join the Unitree developer site for updates and support.
meta: Open Code. From $42,435. A few stores.
